title: Continuous extension of external-ray rotation number
exact_target: Does the rotation number of rays landing at the fixed point extend uniquely and continuously over the full stated polynomial space, with its prescribed value on unit-modulus multipliers?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300074 (AMR-052-0074). CC BY 4.0.
